_note: Plan 100037: six mutants closing FO-1 (cycle_check manifest gate) and FO-3 (plan_lint qa_steps normalization). Each mutant re-opens exactly one fail-open and is killed by exactly one new test. 0 ERROR required.

mutants.name: M1-arm-b-none
mutants.why: Arm B (heading present, stanza does not parse) returning None instead of frozenset() skips the gate — the pre-BAR_MET placeholder shape (*(emitted at BAR_MET)*) silently reaches BAR_MET. Test 1 expects CONTINUE; with None the gate is skipped and BAR_MET passes through.
mutants.anchor:
if not manifest:
        return frozenset()  # arm B: heading exists but stanza did not parse
mutants.replacement:
if not manifest:
        return None  # MUTANT: reverts arm B to fail-open

mutants.name: M2-arm-a-none
mutants.why: Arm A (no ## Cycle Manifest heading) returning None instead of frozenset() skips the gate — plans that never added a manifest section silently reach BAR_MET. Test 2 expects CONTINUE; with None the gate is skipped and BAR_MET passes through.
mutants.anchor:
if not MANIFEST_HEADING_RE.search(plan_text):
        return frozenset()  # arm A: no heading — absence is a defect at BAR_MET
mutants.replacement:
if not MANIFEST_HEADING_RE.search(plan_text):
        return None  # MUTANT: reverts arm A to fail-open

mutants.name: M3-empty-validation-none
mutants.why: An empty validation: field returning None instead of frozenset() skips the gate — a manifest stanza whose validation row is blank silently reaches BAR_MET. test_validation_empty_blocks expects CONTINUE; with None the gate is skipped.
mutants.anchor:
if not validation_val:
        return frozenset()  # validation field absent or empty
mutants.replacement:
if not validation_val:
        return None  # MUTANT: reverts empty-validation guard to fail-open

mutants.name: M4-revert-fo3-normalization
mutants.why: Reverting to the original truthy check makes qa_steps: none (truthy string) demand a Rule 20 banner. Test 6 expects no (c) FAIL for qa_steps: none; this mutant reinstates the FO-3 bug.

mutants.name: M5-drop-placeholder-branch
mutants.why: Removing the placeholder-specific branch means the template value [comma-separated step numbers] is treated as a real step number — has_qa becomes True and a banner is demanded. Test 9b expects only a WARN and no FAIL; this mutant produces a FAIL.

mutants.name: M6-drop-qa-heading-fallback
mutants.why: Removing the for-loop fallback means plans with no qa_steps header but a step heading containing 'qa' silently skip the banner check. Test 8 has no qa_steps header and a QA heading; without the for loop has_qa stays False and no banner is demanded, so the test's expected (c) FAIL does not appear.
